prompt: An extreme macro close-up detail shot of {{product_name}}, focusing on the exquisite craftsmanship and premium materials. {{product_description}} The camera zooms in on the finest details: the texture of {{product_materials}}, the precision of stitching, the quality of hardware, the grain of the material. Ultra-sharp macro photography revealing every nuance of the {{product_category}}'s construction. Soft directional lighting brings out the texture and depth. This image proves the quality and attention to detail. The shallow depth of field makes the material texture pop against a smooth creamy background. Visible detail features: {{key_features}}.
negative_prompt: out of focus, blurry, low resolution, dirty or smudged, scratches, dust, lint, entire product visible, background clutter, branding in frame, harsh shadows, flat lighting, digital artifact
style: Macro product photography, technical detail documentation, high-end craft showcase, editorial detail shot, texture hero image
composition: Extreme close-up filling at least 80% of frame, diagonal crop showing texture flow, shallow depth of field with 1-2cm sharp zone, abstract composition
lighting: Side lighting at low angle (15-30 degrees) to emphasize texture and depth, softbox diffused light, subtle fill from opposite side, no hotspots
color_palette: True-to-material colors, neutral background (creamy white or soft gray #F0EDE8), product material colors naturally saturated, warm tones for leather/wood, cool for metals
